AUTO-MAS's MaaEnd update step (result 「[更新] Success!」, MaaEnd installing v2.32.0-beta.4 after the finished run) is not a run: no ledger row. The machine (old code) booked it as a failed retry (ledger-2026-10-07.jsonl:4) and kept it to the daily report.

Interim summary (Server酱) once the morning round is done.
Morning shift finished on this boot (booted 08:44), no debug, no skip mark: power off.
「🌙 今晚不关机 / 到点了但没关机：本次开机还没有跑完任何队列」 fired at 21:30:02 as the evening shift began (due time = the last queue's start); the message is gone.
Daily report after the evening shift.
Evening shift finished on this boot (booted 21:19), no debug, no skip mark: power off.

Both power-offs (09:55, 21:51) end with the stop-time state push while Windows closes AUTO-MAS; the snapshot must not read the dying backend. On the machine nothing was pushed this day, but the phone state's queues / Arknights config came out empty (R05's 10-07 instance).
AUTO-MAS exits inside the relay's own power-off (09:55:32, 21:51:05, exit code 0x1): that is the shutdown, not a crash; the machine logged 「按关机处理，不算故障，不再重新打开它」.
The WMI process-start listener drops as Windows goes down after the relay's own power-off (09:55:34, 21:51:10): one INFO 「按关机处理，不算故障」, no ERROR.

Not judged on 10-07: MAA's own log (debug/asst.log) is recorded only from 2026-10-10 14:46:33 (seed.json notes; asst.bak.log starts there), so the sim cannot read the run's infrastructure lines and the relay says 「能读到 MAA 自己的日志」 failed. The machine read it and booked the run silently (✅ 静默记账). 10-07 does not test the MAA verdict path.
As 1007-15, the evening MAA run: asst.log not recorded for 10-07; the machine booked it silently.

items.why: A real failure the machine missed: MaaEnd's own log (debug/2026-10-07-2.log lines 180-185, 09:30:08) has six 「选项 "AutoStockBuy…" 的类型已从 "checkbox" 变更为 "switch"，已重置为默认值」, so 自动囤货 bought by MaaEnd's defaults, not the owner's lists. The old code knew only the 「已丢弃保存值」 wording and booked the run silently (relay.log 10-07 09:53:11); since c1c80674 both wordings fail the 「新版本认得全部旧设置」 check and push.

Machine check #20 must agree with the game's own numbers. The run log (history/2026-10-07/endfield/MaaEnd-05-29-05.log) reads 当前理智 277 -> 117 around a double claim (折金票 68000, 160 sanity), then a half claim (34000, 80 sanity) and 「理智不足」: 37 left, the figure the collector's per-claim rule gives (4efee4f2; its comment names this day: 「10-07 277 -> 117 -> half claim, and the next day's first reading fits 37 left, not 0」). #20 still takes one run as the largest drop between readings (160) and wants 0, so it reports the correct 37 as wrong. Not fixed at 79da6cb5: reported as a relay bug.

The daily report's Endfield next banner must come from the version briefing (up since 2026-10-06 20:00, bulletin cid 2183; the sim serves the 10-08 recording ef-briefing-v1d6), not say 「官方未公告」 as the machine's report did this evening. Owner noticed it 10-08 13:12 (errors R22); his words not found in 报错台账.txt / 被指出.txt: 待核.
